baseline_failures_preserved.independent_review_failure: Finite values [1e308,1e308] versus [0,0] produced infinite means and NaN interval endpoints before scaled reductions were added.

decisions.observation: The report combined an A-only mean and interval with an A-versus-B paired test. A fixed absolute permutation tolerance changed results with units; a variance floor manufactured finite standardized effects. Independent review then reproduced finite-input overflow at 1e308.
decisions.hypothesized_cause: The report combined an A-only mean and interval with an A-versus-B paired test. A fixed absolute permutation tolerance changed results with units; a variance floor manufactured finite standardized effects. Independent review then reproduced finite-input overflow at 1e308.
decisions.change: Report the paired mean difference and its paired bootstrap interval; keep method means separate; validate aligned finite one-dimensional pairs and resampling parameters; use relative normalized sign-flip tails; return null for undefined standardized effects; normalize mean, variance and quantile reductions before restoring units.
decisions.predicted_consequence: A constant paired difference has a constant interval even when the individual methods vary. Scaling units preserves the sampled sign-flip p-value; representable extreme means and intervals stay finite.
decisions.discriminating_experiment: Compare the new regression fixtures with the original base source, then run relevant existing checks.
decisions.result: See retained verification receipt; no efficacy result is inferred.
